back.en: Net rate of heat flow is zero; both objects at the same temperature
back.bm: Kadar aliran haba bersih sifar; kedua-dua objek pada suhu sama

back.en: It reaches thermal equilibrium with the object, then shows the same temperature
back.bm: Ia mencapai keseimbangan terma dengan objek, lalu menunjukkan suhu yang sama

back.en: Heat to raise 1 kg by 1 °C. Q = mcθ. Water: 4200 J kg⁻¹ °C⁻¹
back.bm: Haba untuk naikkan 1 kg sebanyak 1 °C. Q = mcθ. Air: 4200 J kg⁻¹ °C⁻¹

back.en: Land heats faster (lower c), warm air rises over land, cool sea air moves in
back.bm: Daratan cepat panas (c rendah), udara panas naik di darat, udara laut yang sejuk bergerak masuk

back.en: Heat to change the state of 1 kg at constant temperature. Q = mL
back.bm: Haba untuk tukar keadaan 1 kg pada suhu malar. Q = mL

front.en: Latent heat of fusion vs vaporisation

back.en: Fusion: solid ↔ liquid. Vaporisation: liquid ↔ gas (larger value)
back.bm: Pelakuran: pepejal ↔ cecair. Pengewapan: cecair ↔ gas (nilai lebih besar)

front.en: Why temperature is constant while melting

back.en: Heat breaks bonds between particles (potential energy), not kinetic energy
back.bm: Haba memutuskan ikatan antara zarah (tenaga keupayaan), bukan tenaga kinetik

back.en: Constant P: V ∝ T (kelvin), V₁/T₁ = V₂/T₂
back.bm: P malar: V ∝ T (kelvin), V₁/T₁ = V₂/T₂

back.en: Constant V: P ∝ T (kelvin), P₁/T₁ = P₂/T₂
back.bm: V malar: P ∝ T (kelvin), P₁/T₁ = P₂/T₂
